title: Extend knowledge check with body link validation (md + wiki links)
action: In check_bundle add two profile warnings over each non-reserved .md body: dangling_md_link — a relative link ending in .md (skip http(s)/mailto/absolute/anchor-only) resolved against the containing file dir must exist and stay inside the bundle; dangling_wiki_link — [[target]] resolves when target, or target minus an optional pattern- prefix, matches the stem of any .md in the bundle. Reuse the existing warning plumbing and code style. Unit tests in tests.rs on temp bundles: resolving md link clean, dangling md link warns, wiki link with and without pattern- prefix clean, dangling wiki link warns, http link ignored.

truths: Both warning codes appear in check output with file and target named
External and anchor-only links never warn
Existing check warnings and exit-code semantics unchanged (warnings stay non-strict-clean)
New unit tests cover both codes green and red

trace.outcome: check_bundle now warns on dangling body links (md and wiki)
